H01-SCH: SELECT T1.bez, T2.kennz, COUNT(T2.flug_id) AS flug_count FROM flghf AS T1 JOIN lfz AS T2 ON T1.fh_nr = T2.heimat_fh_nr JOIN flug AS T3 ON T2.lfz_nr = T3.lfz_nr WHERE T3.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY T1.bez, T2.kennz ORDER BY flug_count DESC, T2.kennz ASC LIMIT 1
H01-BIZ: SELECT flgesbez, lfzbez, COUNT(flug_id) AS completed_flights FROM flges JOIN lfz ON flges.flges_nr = lfz.flges_nr JOIN flug ON lfz.lfz_nr = flug.lfz_nr WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY flgesbez, lfzbez ORDER BY completed_flights DESC
H01-VAG: SELECT flgesbez, lfzbez, COUNT(*) as flight_count FROM flges JOIN lfz ON flges.flges_nr = lfz.flges_nr JOIN flug ON lfz.lfz_nr = flug.lfz_nr GROUP BY flgesbez, lfzbez ORDER BY flight_count DESC LIMIT 1
H02-CAS: SELECT f.ort, a.allianz FROM flghf f JOIN flug l ON f.fh_nr = l.abfl_fh JOIN flges a ON l.flges_nr = a.flges_nr WHERE l.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY f.ort, a.allianz ORDER BY f.ort, COUNT(l.flug_id) DESC
H02-SCH: SELECT f1.iata_cd, f1.bez, COUNT(f2.flug_id) AS count FROM flghf f1 JOIN flug f2 ON f2.ziel_fh = f1.fh_nr AND f2.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY f1.iata_cd, f1.bez ORDER BY count DESC, f1.bez LIMIT 1
H02-BIZ: SELECT flghf.ort, flges.bez, COUNT(flug.flug_id) AS completed_arrivals FROM flug JOIN flghf ON flug.ank_ist IS NOT NULL AND flug.ank_ist <> '' AND flug.ziel_fh = flghf(fh_nr) JOIN flges ON flug.flges_nr = flges.flges_nr WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY flghf.ort, flges.bez ORDER BY flghf.ort, completed_arrivals DESC
H02-VAG: SELECT f.bez, COUNT(DISTINCT s.sndg_nr) AS flight_count FROM flghf f JOIN flug fl ON f.fh_nr = fl.abfl_fh JOIN sndg s ON fl.flug_id = s.flug_id GROUP BY f.bez ORDER BY flight_count DESC LIMIT 1
H03-CAS: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', rech_kopf.ausst_dat) AS month, SUM(rech_kopf.brutto_usd) AS invoice_amount, SUM(SUM(rech_kopf.brutto_usd)) OVER (ORDER BY strftime('%Y-%m', rech_kopf.ausst_dat)) AS running_total FROM rech_kopf WHERE strftime('%Y', rech_kopf.ausst_dat) = '2025' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
H03-SCH: SELECT SUBSTR(ausst_dat, 1, 7) AS month, SUM(brutto_usd) AS total_brutto_usd, SUM(SUM(brutto_usd)) OVER (ORDER BY SUBSTR(ausst_dat, 1, 7)) AS running_total_brutto_usd FROM rech_kopf WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', ausst_dat) = '2025' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
H03-BIZ: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', rech_kopf.ausst_dat) AS month, SUM(rech_kopf.brutto_usd) AS billed_revenue, SUM(SUM(rech_kopf.brutto_usd)) OVER (ORDER BY strftime('%Y-%m', rech_kopf.ausst_dat)) AS ytd_cumulative_revenue FROM rech_kopf WHERE strftime('%Y', rech_kopf.ausst_dat) = '2025' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
H03-VAG: SELECT SUM(fracht_usd) AS total_revenue FROM rech_kopf WHERE stat = 'paid'
H04-CAS: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', f.abfl_plan) AS month, COUNT(f.flug_id) AS flights_completed, LAG(COUNT(f.flug_id)) OVER (ORDER BY strftime('%Y-%m', f.abfl_plan)) - COUNT(f.flug_id) AS change_from_previous_month FROM flug f WHERE f.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', f.abfl_plan) ORDER BY month
H04-SCH: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', abfl_ist) AS month, COUNT(*) AS completed_flights, LAG(COUNT(*)) OVER (ORDER BY strftime('%Y-%m', abfl_ist)) - COUNT(*) AS difference FROM flug WHERE stat = 'completed' GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', abfl_ist) ORDER BY month
H04-BIZ: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', flug.abfl_plan) AS month, COUNT(flug_id) AS completed_flights, LAG(COUNT(flug_id)) OVER (ORDER BY strftime('%Y-%m', flug.abfl_plan)) - COUNT(flug_id) AS month_over_month_change FROM flug WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', flug.abfl_plan) ORDER BY month
H04-VAG: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', flug.abfl_plan) AS month, COUNT(*) AS flight_count FROM flug GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
H05-CAS: SELECT l.kennz, AVG(f.ank_ist - f.abfl_ist) AS avg_ground_time FROM lfz l JOIN flug f ON l.lfz_nr = f.lfz_nr WHERE f.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY l.kennz ORDER BY avg_ground_time ASC LIMIT 5
H05-SCH: SELECT l.kennz, AVG(julianday(f.abfl_ist) - julianday(f.ank_ist)) AS avg_time_diff FROM lfz l JOIN flug f ON l.lfz_nr = f.lfz_nr WHERE f.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY l.kennz ORDER BY avg_time_diff ASC LIMIT 5
H05-BIZ: SELECT l.lfz_nr, l.kennz, AVG(f.abfl_ist - f.ank_ist) AS avg_turnaround FROM lfz l JOIN flug f ON l.lfz_nr = f.lfz_nr WHERE f.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY l.lfz_nr, l.kennz ORDER BY avg_turnaround ASC LIMIT 5
H05-VAG: SELECT flug_id, abfl_ist, ank_ist, ABS(STRFTIME('%s', ank_ist) - STRFTIME('%s', abfl_ist)) AS turnaround_time FROM flug ORDER BY turnaround_time ASC LIMIT 10
H06-CAS: SELECT kunnr, SUM(fracht_usd) AS total_invoiced, (SUM(fracht_usd) / (SELECT SUM(fracht_usd) FROM rech_kopf)) * 100 AS share FROM knd_stamm JOIN sndg ON knd_stamm.kunnr = sndg.kunnr JOIN rech_kopf ON sndg.sndg_nr = rech_kopf.sndg_nr GROUP BY kunnr HAVING total_invoiced > (SELECT SUM(fracht_usd) * 0.04 FROM rech_kopf)
H06-SCH: SELECT knd_stamm.name1, SUM(rech_kopf.brutto_usd) / (SELECT SUM(brutto_usd) FROM rech_kopf) AS avg_brutto_per_customer FROM sndg JOIN knd_stamm ON sndg.kunnr = knd_stamm.kunnr JOIN rech_kopf ON sndg.sndg_nr = rech_kopf.sndg_nr GROUP BY knd_stamm.name1 HAVING avg_brutto_per_customer > 0.04
H06-BIZ: SELECT kunnr, SUM(fracht_usd) AS revenue, SUM(fracht_usd) * 100 / (SELECT SUM(fracht_usd) FROM rech_kopf) AS share FROM rech_kopf GROUP BY kunnr HAVING SUM(fracht_usd) * 100 / (SELECT SUM(fracht_usd) FROM rech_kopf) > 4
H06-VAG: SELECT knd_stamm.name1, knd_stamm.kto_cd, SUM(rech_kopf.fracht_usd) AS total_revenue FROM knd_stamm JOIN sndg ON knd_stamm.kunnr = sndg.kunnr JOIN rech_kopf ON sndg.sndg_nr = rech_kopf.sndg_nr GROUP BY knd_stamm.kunnr ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
H07-CAS: SELECT f.ort, SUM(s.fracht_gew_kg) AS total_cargo FROM flghf f JOIN sndg s ON f.fh_nr = s.urspr_fh GROUP BY f.ort ORDER BY total_cargo DESC LIMIT 5
H07-SCH: SELECT flghf.ort, SUM(sndg.ges_gew_kg / 1000) AS tonnes, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(sndg.ges_gew_kg / 1000) DESC) AS rank FROM flug_ladg JOIN sndg ON flug_ladg.sndg_nr = sndg.sndg_nr JOIN flug ON flug_ladg.flug_id = flug.flug_id JOIN flghf ON flug.abfl_fh = flghf(fh_nr) GROUP BY flghf.ort ORDER BY rank LIMIT 5
H07-BIZ: SELECT flghf.ort, SUM(sndg.fracht_gew_kg) AS outbound_tonnage FROM flghf JOIN flug ON flghf.fh_nr = flug.urspr_fh JOIN sndg ON flug.flug_id = sndg.flug_id GROUP BY flghf.ort ORDER BY outbound_tonnage DESC LIMIT 5
H07-VAG: SELECT flghf.ort, COUNT(zoll_anm.anm_id) AS export_count FROM flghf JOIN zoll_anm ON flghf.fh_nr = zoll_anm.lgr_nr WHERE zoll_anm.anm_art = 'export' GROUP BY flghf.ort ORDER BY export_count DESC LIMIT 10
H08-CAS: SELECT lftyp.mdl, COUNT(flg.flug_id) AS completed_flights_more_than_half_full FROM lfz JOIN lfz_typ lftyp ON lfz.typ_nr = lftyp.typ_nr JOIN flug flg ON lfz.lfz_nr = flg.lfz_nr WHERE flg.stat = 'completed' AND flg.entf_km > (SELECT AVG(entf_km) * 0.5 FROM flug WHERE stat = 'completed') GROUP BY lftyp.mdl
H08-SCH: SELECT l.mdl, COUNT(f.flug_id) AS completed_flights FROM lfz l JOIN lfz_typ lt ON l.typ_nr = lt.typ_nr JOIN flug_ladg fl ON l.lfz_nr = fl.lfz_nr JOIN flug f ON fl.flug_id = f.flug_id WHERE fl.abschn_stat = 'completed' GROUP BY l.mdl HAVING SUM(fl.ges_vol_m3) > 0.5 * lt.max_vol_m3
H08-BIZ: SELECT l.lfz_nr, l.msn, COUNT(f.flug_id) AS completed_flights FROM lfz l JOIN flug f ON l.lfz_nr = f.lfz_nr WHERE f.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY l.lfz_nr, l.msn HAVING SUM(f.entf_km * l.max_vol_m3) / COUNT(f.flug_id) * 100 > 50
H08-VAG: SELECT T1.mdl FROM lfz_typ AS T1 INNER JOIN lfz AS T2 ON T1.typ_nr = T2.typ_nr WHERE T2.ges_flugstd BETWEEN T2.anz_slb * 0.5 AND T2.anz_slb * 1.5
H09-CAS: SELECT lfl.lfz_nr, lfl.kennz FROM lfz lfl JOIN flug_ladg flg_l ON lfl.lfz_nr = flg_l.lfz_nr JOIN flug flg ON flg_l.flug_id = flg.flug_id JOIN flghf fh ON flg.abfl_fh = fh.fh_nr WHERE fh.reg = 'middle_east' GROUP BY lfl.lfz_nr, lfl.kennz HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT fh.ort) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flghf WHERE reg = 'middle_east')
H09-SCH: SELECT DISTINCT l.kennz FROM lfz l JOIN flug f ON l.lfz_nr = f.ziel_fh JOIN flghf fh ON f.ziel_fh = fh.fh_nr WHERE fh.hub_kz = 1 AND f.stat = 'completed'
H09-BIZ: SELECT DISTINCT lfl.lfz_nr, lfl.kennz FROM lfz lfl JOIN flug flg ON lfl.lfz_nr = flg.lfz_nr WHERE flg.stat = 'completed' AND lfl.eigt_art = 'owned'
H09-VAG: SELECT DISTINCT flghf.bez FROM flghf JOIN flug ON flghf(fh_nr) = flug.abfl_fh GROUP BY flghf.bez HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT flug.ziel_fh) > 1
H10-CAS: SELECT zoll_land, COUNT(*) AS freq FROM zoll_anm WHERE zolltarif_nr IN ( SELECT zolltarif_nr FROM zoll_anm WHERE zoll_betr_usd > ges_gew_kg * zollsatz_pct * 1.2 ) GROUP BY zoll_land
H10-SCH: SELECT zoll_land, COUNT(*) FROM zoll_anm WHERE zoll_art = 'import' AND zoll_betr_usd + eust_usd > 0.2 * zollwert_usd GROUP BY zoll_land
H10-BIZ: SELECT zoll_land, COUNT(*) FROM zoll_anm WHERE zollsatz_pct > 20
H10-VAG: SELECT zoll_land FROM zoll_anm WHERE zollsatz_pct > 10
H11-CAS: SELECT lgr.lgr_cd, MAX(sdg_verfolg.ereig_zeit - flug.ank_ist) AS time_difference FROM sdg_verfolg JOIN flug ON sdg_verfolg.flug_id = flug.flug_id JOIN lgr ON sdg_verfolg.lgr_nr = lgr.lgr_nr WHERE sdg_verfolg.ereig_cd = 'DLV' GROUP BY lgr.lgr_cd ORDER BY time_difference DESC LIMIT 3
H11-SCH: SELECT lgr_cd, AVG((strftime('%s', DLV.ereig_zeit) - strftime('%s', RCF.ereig_zeit)) / 3600) AS avg_hours FROM sdg_verfolg RCF JOIN sdg_verfolg DLV ON RCF.sndg_nr = DLV.sndg_nr AND RCF.lgr_nr = DLV.lgr_nr AND RCF.ereig_cd = 'RCF' AND DLV.ereig_cd = 'DLV' GROUP BY lgr_cd HAVING COUNT(DLV.ereig_id) >= 20 ORDER BY avg_hours DESC LIMIT 3
H11-BIZ: SELECT lgr.lgr_cd, MAX(sdg_verfolg.ereig_zeit - flug.ank_ist) AS dwell_time FROM sdg_verfolg JOIN flug ON sdg_verfolg.flug_id = flug.flug_id JOIN lgr ON sdg_verfolg.lgr_nr = lgr.lgr_nr WHERE sdg_verfolg.ereig_cd = 'DLV' GROUP BY lgr.lgr_cd ORDER BY dwell_time DESC LIMIT 3
H11-VAG: SELECT lgr.lgr_cd, AVG(sdg_verfolg.ereig_zeit) AS avg_delivery_time FROM lgr JOIN sdg_verfolg ON lgr.lgr_nr = sdg_verfolg.lgr_nr GROUP BY lgr.lgr_cd ORDER BY avg_delivery_time DESC LIMIT 1
H12-CAS: SELECT flghf.ort, COUNT(sndg.sndg_nr) AS shipment_count FROM flghf JOIN flug ON flghf.fh_nr = flug.abfl_fh JOIN sndg ON flug.flug_id = sndg.flug_id GROUP BY flghf.ort ORDER BY shipment_count DESC LIMIT 5
H12-SCH: SELECT sndg.iata_cd, AVG((strftime('%s', sdg2.ereig_zeit) - strftime('%s', sdg1.ereig_zeit)) / 3600) AS avg_gap_hours FROM sndg JOIN sdg_verfolg sdg1 ON sndg.sndg_nr = sdg1.sndg_nr AND sdg1.ereig_cd = 'RCS' JOIN sdg_verfolg sdg2 ON sndg.sndg_nr = sdg2.sndg_nr AND sdg2.ereig_cd = 'DLV' AND sdg2.ereig_zeit > sdg1.ereig_zeit GROUP BY sndg.iata_cd ORDER BY avg_gap_hours DESC LIMIT 5
H12-BIZ: SELECT flghf.ort, AVG(flug.ank_ist - flug.abfl_ist) AS avg_lead_time FROM flug JOIN flghf ON flug.abfl_fh = flghf(fh_nr) GROUP BY flghf.ort ORDER BY avg_lead_time DESC LIMIT 5
H12-VAG: SELECT T1.sitz_ort FROM flges AS T1 JOIN flug_ladg AS T2 ON T1.flges_nr = T2.flug_id ORDER BY T2.abschn_stat = 'planned' DESC LIMIT 1
H13-CAS: SELECT lftyp.mdl, MAX(wartg.teile_kost_usd) AS max_maintenance_cost FROM lfz JOIN lfz_typ lftyp ON lfz.typ_nr = lftyp.typ_nr JOIN wartg ON lfz.lfz_nr = wartg.lfz_nr WHERE wartg.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY lftyp.mdl ORDER BY max_maintenance_cost DESC LIMIT 1
H13-SCH: SELECT auftr_nr, teile_kost_usd + lohn_kost_usd AS total_cost FROM wartg WHERE stat = 'completed' ORDER BY total_cost DESC LIMIT 1
H13-BIZ: SELECT l.lfz_nr, l.msn, lgr.lgr_typ, SUM(w.teile_kost_usd + w.lohn_kost_usd) AS total_cost FROM lfz l JOIN wartg w ON l.lfz_nr = w.lfz_nr JOIN lgr ON w.lgr_nr = lgr.lgr_nr WHERE w.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY l.lfz_nr, l.msn, lgr.lgr_typ ORDER BY total_cost DESC LIMIT 1
H13-VAG: SELECT lftyp.mdl, MAX(wartg.teile_kost_usd) AS max_repair_cost FROM lfz JOIN lfz_typ lftyp ON lfz.typ_nr = lftyp.typ_nr JOIN wartg ON lfz.lfz_nr = wartg.lfz_nr GROUP BY lftyp.mdl ORDER BY max_repair_cost DESC LIMIT 1
H14-CAS: SELECT flgesbez, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN versp_cd = 'late' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS late_percentage FROM flug JOIN flges ON flug.flges_nr = flges.flges_nr WHERE stat = 'completed' GROUP BY flgesbez
H14-SCH: SELECT bez, COUNT(*) AS completed_flug, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%M', abfl_ist) - strftime('%M', abfl_plan) > 15 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage_over_15_minutes FROM flug JOIN flghf ON flug.abfl_fh = flghf(fh_nr) WHERE stat = 'completed' GROUP BY bez
H14-BIZ: SELECT flgesbez, COUNT(*) AS D15 FROM flug JOIN flges ON flug.flges_nr = flges.flges_nr WHERE versp_cd = 'D15' GROUP BY flgesbez
H14-VAG: SELECT kunnr, COUNT(*) AS late_count FROM sndg WHERE stat = 'cancelled' GROUP BY kunnr ORDER BY late_count DESC LIMIT 1
H15-CAS: SELECT knd_stamm.treue_stufe, AVG(rech_kopf.rabatt_usd / rech_kopf.fracht_usd * 100) AS avg_discount_pct FROM knd_stamm JOIN sndg ON knd_stamm.kunnr = sndg.kunnr JOIN rech_kopf ON sndg.sndg_nr = rech_kopf.sndg_nr GROUP BY knd_stamm.treue_stufe
H15-SCH: SELECT treue_stufe, ROUND(AVG(100 * rabatt_usd / (brutto_usd + rabatt_usd)), 2) AS avg_discount_rate FROM knd_stamm JOIN rech_kopf ON knd_stamm.kunnr = rech_kopf.kunnr GROUP BY treue_stufe
H15-BIZ: SELECT knd_stamm.treue_stufe, AVG(rech_kopf.rabatt_usd) AS avg_discount_rate FROM knd_stamm JOIN sndg ON knd_stamm.kunnr = sndg.kunnr JOIN rech_kopf ON sndg.sndg_nr = rech_kopf.sndg_nr GROUP BY knd_stamm.treue_stufe
H15-VAG: SELECT knd_typ, AVG(rabatt_usd) AS avg_discount FROM knd_stamm JOIN rech_kopf ON knd_stamm.kunnr = rech_kopf.kunnr GROUP BY knd_typ
H16-CAS: SELECT flug_id, COUNT(*) AS times FROM betankg WHERE menge_kg * 100 / max_slb_m > 95 GROUP BY flug_id
H16-SCH: SELECT l.kennz, COUNT(f.flug_id) AS flug_count FROM lfz l JOIN flug f ON l.lfz_nr = f.lfz_nr WHERE f.tow_kg > 0.95 * l.mtow_kg GROUP BY l.kennz
H16-BIZ: SELECT l.msn, COUNT(*) AS freq FROM lfz l JOIN lfz_typ lt ON l.typ_nr = lt.typ_nr WHERE (l.mtow_kg * 0.95) < l.ges_flugstd GROUP BY l.msn ORDER BY freq DESC
H16-VAG: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flug WHERE tow_kg > 10000
H17-CAS: SELECT kunnr, AVG(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(wkurs_dat, 6, 2) BETWEEN '01' AND '06' THEN wkurs_usd ELSE NULL END) AS avg_wkurs_first_half, AVG(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(wkurs_dat, 6, 2) BETWEEN '07' AND '12' THEN wkurs_usd ELSE NULL END) AS avg_wkurs_second_half FROM zahlg WHERE wkurs_dat BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY kunnr
H17-SCH: SELECT orig_waehr, AVG(wkurs_usd) AS avg_wkurs_usd FROM zahlg WHERE zahl_dat < '2025-07-01' GROUP BY orig_waehr UNION ALL SELECT orig_waehr, AVG(wkurs_usd) AS avg_wkurs_usd FROM zahlg WHERE zahl_dat >= '2025-07-01' GROUP BY orig_waehr
H17-BIZ: SELECT kunnr, AVG(wkurs_usd) AS avg_wkurs_usd FROM zahlg WHERE ausst_dat BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-06-30' GROUP BY kunnr UNION ALL SELECT kunnr, AVG(wkurs_usd) AS avg_wkurs_usd FROM zahlg WHERE ausst_dat BETWEEN '2025-07-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY kunnr
H17-VAG: SELECT AVG(wkurs_usd) AS avg_wkurs_usd FROM zahlg WHERE zahl_dat BETWEEN '2022-01-01' AND '2022-06-30' UNION ALL SELECT AVG(wkurs_usd) AS avg_wkurs_usd FROM zahlg WHERE zahl_dat BETWEEN '2022-07-01' AND '2022-12-31'
H18-CAS: SELECT DISTINCT f1.ort, f2.ort FROM flug f1 JOIN flug f2 ON f1.ziel_fh = f2.abfl_fh AND f1.flug_id < f2.flug_id WHERE julianday(f2.abfl_plan) - julianday(f1.ank_ist) > 2
H18-SCH: SELECT f1.iata_cd, COUNT(*) FROM flug_ladg f1 JOIN flug_ladg f2 ON f1.sndg_nr = f2.sndg_nr AND f1.ladg_id < f2.ladg_id JOIN flug f ON f1.flug_id = f.flug_id AND f2.flug_id = f.flug_id WHERE f1.abschn_stat = 'completed' AND f2.abschn_stat = 'completed' AND julianday(f2.abfl_ist) - julianday(f1.ank_ist) > 2 GROUP BY f1.iata_cd
H18-BIZ: SELECT s1.urspr_fh, s2.ziel_fh, julianday(s2.buch_dat) - julianday(s1.wunsch_lief_dat) AS days_diff FROM sndg s1 JOIN sndg s2 ON s1.lbf_nr = s2.lbf_nr AND s1.kunnr = s2.kunnr WHERE s1.stat = 'delivered' AND s2.stat = 'booked' AND julianday(s2.buch_dat) - julianday(s1.wunsch_lief_dat) > 2
H18-VAG: SELECT flghf.ort, flghf.zeitz, flghf.breite, flghf.laenge, flghf.hoehe_m, flghf.anz_slb, flghf.max_slb_m, flghf.hub_kz, flghf.kap_jahr_t, flghf.zoll_24h_kz, flghf.nachtflugverb_kz FROM flghf WHERE flghf.anz_slb > 10
H19-CAS: SELECT versicherer, COUNT(schad_id) AS paid_claims, AVG(julianday(entsch_dat) - julianday(meld_dat)) AS avg_days_to_payment FROM vers_schad WHERE stat = 'paid' GROUP BY versicherer
H19-SCH: SELECT versicherer, COUNT(*) AS paid_count, AVG((strftime('%J', reg_dat) - strftime('%J', meld_dat))) AS avg_days FROM vers_schad WHERE stat = 'paid' GROUP BY versicherer
H19-BIZ: SELECT v.versicherer, AVG(julianday(v.entsch_dat) - julianday(v.meld_dat)) AS avg_days_to_settlement FROM vers_schad v WHERE v.stat = 'paid' GROUP BY v.versicherer ORDER BY avg_days_to_settlement ASC LIMIT 1
H19-VAG: SELECT AVG(genehm_usd) AS avg_genehmigungszeit FROM vers_schad WHERE stat = 'approved'
H20-CAS: SELECT T1.vorname, T1.nachname, T2.vorname, T2.nachname FROM bes_mitgl AS T1 JOIN bes_eins AS TE1 ON T1.pers_nr = TE1.pers_nr JOIN flug AS T2 ON TE1.flug_id = T2.flug_id JOIN bes_eins AS TE2 ON T2.flug_id = TE2.flug_id AND TE2.pers_nr <> T1.pers_nr WHERE T1.dienstgrad = 'captain' AND T2.dienstgrad = 'first_officer' AND T2.stat = 'completed' GROUP BY T1.pers_nr, T2.pers_nr HAVING COUNT(T2.flug_id) >= 10
H20-SCH: SELECT T1.ma_nr, COUNT(*) AS flight_count FROM bes_eins AS T1 JOIN bes_eins AS T2 ON T1.flug_id = T2.flug_id AND T1.pers_nr <> T2.pers_nr AND T1.dienstgrad = 'captain' AND T2.dienstgrad = 'first_officer' AND T1.eins_stat = 'completed' AND T2.eins_stat = 'completed' GROUP BY T1.ma_nr HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10

H20-VAG: SELECT T1.vorname, T1.nachname, T2.vorname, T2.nachname FROM bes_mitgl AS T1 JOIN bes_eins AS T2 ON T1.pers_nr = T2.pers_nr JOIN flug AS T3 ON T2.flug_id = T3.flug_id WHERE T1.dienstgrad = 'captain' AND T2.dienstgrad = 'first_officer' GROUP BY T1.vorname, T1.nachname, T2.vorname, T2.nachname HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT T3.flug_id) > 1

H39-BIZ: SELECT knd_stamm.name1, knd_stamm.land, COUNT(sndg.sndg_nr) AS shipment_count FROM knd_stamm JOIN sndg ON knd_stamm.kunnr = sndg.kunnr WHERE sndg.stat = 'delivered' GROUP BY knd_stamm.name1, knd_stamm.land HAVING shipment_count >= 60
H39-VAG: SELECT T1.bez AS destination, COUNT(T2.flug_id) AS visit_count FROM flghf AS T1 JOIN flug AS T2 ON T1.fh_nr = T2.ziel_fh GROUP BY T1.bez ORDER BY visit_count DESC LIMIT 10
H40-CAS: SELECT knd_typ, AVG(julianday(zahl_dat2) - julianday(zahl_dat1)) AS days_between FROM ( SELECT kunnr, MIN(zahl_dat) AS zahl_dat1, MAX(zahl_dat) AS zahl_dat2 FROM zahlg GROUP BY kunnr HAVING COUNT(zahl_dat) = 2 ) JOIN knd_stamm ON knd_stamm.kunnr = zahlg.kunnr GROUP BY knd_typ
H40-SCH: SELECT AVG(MAX(zahl_dat) - MIN(zahl_dat)) AS avg_diff, knd_typ, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM zahlg JOIN rech_kopf ON zahlg.rech_id = rech_kopf.rech_id JOIN sndg ON rech_kopf.sndg_nr = sndg.sndg_nr JOIN knd_stamm ON sndg.kunnr = knd_stamm.kunnr GROUP BY knd_typ HAVING COUNT(*) = 2
H40-BIZ: SELECT knd_stamm.vertr_reg, AVG(zahlg.betr_usd) AS avg_second_installment FROM zahlg JOIN rech_kopf ON zahlg.rech_id = rech_kopf.rech_id JOIN sndg ON rech_kopf.sndg_nr = sndg.sndg_nr JOIN knd_stamm ON sndg.kunnr = knd_stamm.kunnr WHERE zahlg.abgestimmt_kz = 1 AND zahlg.zahl_ref LIKE '%/%' GROUP BY knd_stamm.vertr_reg
H40-VAG: SELECT kunnr, SUM(zahlbed_tg) AS total_zahlbed_tg, SUM(brutto_usd) AS total_brutto_usd FROM knd_stamm JOIN zahlg ON knd_stamm.kunnr = zahlg.kunnr JOIN rech_kopf ON zahlg.rech_id = rech_kopf.rech_id GROUP BY kunnr ORDER BY total_zahlbed_tg - total_brutto_usd DESC
